opening.argument: The lesson walks through Bing Webmaster Tools as part of an Urdu/Hindi SEO course. The presenter explains importing a site and describes sites brought over from Google Search Console as automatically verified. The accompanying screens show the dashboard and concrete controls for submitting URLs and scheduling crawls. Those are demonstrations of website management, not a deceptive offer. References to blog or WordPress sites fit the course subject, while requests to like, share, or subscribe serve ordinary audience engagement. Nothing in the cited material connects those elements to required financial participation or establishes a deceptive outcome.
